```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(flexdashboard)
library (p8105.datasets)
library(plotly)

```

Column {data-width=650}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Chart A

```{r}
 data(instacart)
instacart = instacart|>
    mutate(day = factor(order_dow, levels = 0:6,
                      labels = c("Sun", "Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri", "Sat")))

instacart_df = instacart |>
  count(aisle) |>
  filter(n > 10000)|>
  mutate(aisle = fct_reorder (aisle, n))|>
  plot_ly (x = ~aisle, y = ~n, color = ~aisle, 
           type = "bar", colors = "viridis")|>
   layout (title = "Items ordered per aisle for aisles with more than 10000 items", 
          xaxis = list(title =""),
          yaxis = list(title = "Number of items"), 
          showlegend = FALSE)
 
```

Column {data-width=350}
-----------------------------------------------------------------------

### Chart B

```{r}
set.seed(1)

instacart_df = instacart|>
  sample_n(10000)|>
  mutate (department = fct_reorder(department, order_hour_of_day))|>
  plot_ly(y = ~order_hour_of_day, color = ~department, type = "box", colors = "viridis")|>
  layout(title = "Items ordered across hours of the day by department",
         xaxis = list(title=""), 
         yaxis = list("Hour of the day"), 
         showlegend = FALSE)


```

### Chart C

```{r}
instacart_df = instacart |>
  distinct(order_id, day, order_hour_of_day)|>
  count(day, order_hour_of_day)|>
  plot_ly(x = ~order_hour_of_day, y = ~day, z = ~n, type="heatmap", colors = "viridis")|>
  layout (title = "Number of orders by day and hour", 
          xaxis = list(title = "Hour of the day"), 
          yaxis = list(title=""))
```
